# PhotoNow MCP Engine

> The #1 Offline Photo & Video Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tool Server Built Specifically for AI Agents.

PhotoNow provides autonomous AI agents (Claude Desktop, Google Antigravity, Cursor, LangChain, AutoGen) with high-performance, 100% offline client-side media transformation tools. All processing executes in-memory via HTML5 Canvas 2D, MediaRecorder, and Web Audio APIs. Zero server uploads. Zero cloud latency. Zero API billing.

## Core Documentation

- [Home & Web Workbench](https://photonow.vercel.app/): Main offline client-side application workbench for photos and videos.
- [MCP Architecture & Specs](https://photonow.vercel.app/ARCHITECTURE.md): Complete architecture document, JSON-RPC 2.0 schemas, and tool definitions.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Sibasish2005/PhotoNowEngine): Open source code, integration instructions, and local agent integration tests.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://photonow.vercel.app/terms): Intellectual property, agent usage license, and client disclaimer.
- [Privacy Policy](https://photonow.vercel.app/privacy): 100% local client data privacy and zero upload guarantee.
- [Legal Notices](https://photonow.vercel.app/legal): Brand protection, trademark, and copyright declarations.

## Core Capabilities for AI Agents

- [Photo Conversion](https://photonow.vercel.app/): Convert images between WebP, AVIF, PNG, JPEG, and BMP with aspect-locked resizing and Sobel monochrome ink sketch filtering.
- [Video Transcoding](https://photonow.vercel.app/): Transcode video files into optimized WebM (VP9/VP8) with resolution scaling and custom bitrates.
- [Poster Frame Extraction](https://photonow.vercel.app/): Seek to any sub-second timestamp and extract high-resolution snapshot frames.
- [WAV Audio Extraction](https://photonow.vercel.app/): Decode video soundtracks directly into uncompressed 16-bit PCM WAV files.
- [Local Storage Persistence](https://photonow.vercel.app/): Persist binary media in client IndexedDB (`photoConvert_DB`) across sessions with ZIP archive packaging.
- [Agentic Workbench](https://photonow.vercel.app/): Interactive AI agent prompt playground and execution tester.

## MCP Server Endpoint & Specifications

- **Transport**: HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0)
- **Production URL**: [MCP Server Endpoint](https://photonow.vercel.app/api/mcp)
- **Rate Limiting**: Built-in sliding-window quota (60 requests/minute per IP with `X-RateLimit-*` headers)
- **Load Balancing**: Multi-node dispatch engine (`least-connections`, `round-robin`, `weighted`) with auto-healing circuit breakers
- **Security**: 100% Client-Side Private, CORS-enabled, Zero Cloud Storage

## Sample MCP Client Configuration

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "photoNow": {
      "url": "https://photonow.vercel.app/api/mcp",
      "transport": "http",
      "description": "Premier Offline Photo & Video Media Processing Tool Server for AI Agents"
    }
  }
}
```
